title: Nadhif: Check Mac, server and website security | Product Hunt
og:title: Nadhif: Check Mac, server and website security | Product Hunt
og:description: Check Mac security settings, audit Debian/Ubuntu servers over read-only SSH, and inspect websites you own after DNS verification. Then clear developer clutter and use the free cleaner with 7-day restore for most items. Developer and Security tools: about $33 for a lifetime license, no subscription, 7-day trial. macOS 15+, Apple silicon, ~12 MB.

title: nana: One terminal for every coding agent, on Windows | Product Hunt
og:title: nana: One terminal for every coding agent, on Windows | Product Hunt
og:description: Nana is a native terminal multiplexer for Windows. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more side by side, each on its own git worktree. See who is working, waiting or done, review diffs, and keep agents running after you close the app. Free beta.

title: NEXUPIRA: AI teammates that hand back finished work | Product Hunt
og:title: NEXUPIRA: AI teammates that hand back finished work | Product Hunt
og:description: Hire an AI team, not another chat box. Every WhatsApp customer message gets a reply drafted from your own documents, Rex prepares quotes as PDFs, Docu turns receipts and statements into Excel, and Nova keeps your calendar. Set routines that run on schedule. Connect Google Workspace and Notion free; Slack, GitHub and Linear on Pro. Work with your AI team from ChatGPT or Claude (Pro). You approve what goes out. Free to start, Pro US$15/mo.

title: Nock: A notch for Windows, in 1 MB of Rust | Product Hunt
og:title: Nock: A notch for Windows, in 1 MB of Rust | Product Hunt
og:description: A native notch and top bar for Windows (Linux preview). Media, quick tasks, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, power and little animated scenes live at the top of your screen. About 1 MB, about 0% CPU idle, no Electron. Free and MIT licensed. The demo on the site is playable.

title: NoMac: Cloud Macs and iOS Simulators for AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: NoMac: Cloud Macs and iOS Simulators for AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: NoMac gives AI agents their own cloud Mac and iOS Simulator. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client starts a Mac with Xcode in about 30 seconds, builds and tests your app, ships it to TestFlight and the App Store, then shuts it down. You can use the desktop in your browser or the terminal too. Billed per minute, no subscription.

title: Nörth: Natural, peer-to-peer collaboration for remote work | Product Hunt
og:title: Nörth: Natural, peer-to-peer collaboration for remote work | Product Hunt
og:description: Nörth brings remote teams together with spatial voice chat, drop-in rooms, and voice and video messaging. Peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted, and native to macOS.

title: NotchX: Turn your MacBook's notch into a hub for music and calls | Product Hunt
og:title: NotchX: Turn your MacBook's notch into a hub for music and calls | Product Hunt
og:description: NotchX turns your MacBook's camera notch into a live hub: what's playing, messages from Slack, Teams and Messages, calls you can answer or decline, your next meeting and the weather. Everything stays on your Mac. 14-day free trial, then $9.99 once.

title: NotchIsland: Free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch | Product Hunt
og:title: NotchIsland: Free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch | Product Hunt
og:description: NotchIsland turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: a true-black surface that grows out of the notch when something is live (Now Playing, timers, AirPods battery, downloads, notifications) and disappears when nothing is. Hover for a readout; click for a shade with quick toggles, a timer, your next meeting with a Join button, a file Shelf and clipboard history. Option-Space opens a launcher with app search, calculator and unit conversion. Forever free, open source (MIT), macOS 13+.

title: NVIDIA: The official handle for NVIDIA. | Product Hunt
og:title: NVIDIA: The official handle for NVIDIA. | Product Hunt
og:description: NVIDIA, inventor of the GPU, which creates interactive graphics on laptops, workstations, mobile devices, notebooks, PCs, and more. We created the world’s largest gaming platform and the world’s fastest supercomputer. We are the brains of self-driving cars, intelligent machines, and IoT.

title: Obsiva: Turn site pics + voice notes into a PDF inspection report | Product Hunt
og:title: Obsiva: Turn site pics + voice notes into a PDF inspection report | Product Hunt
og:description: Obsiva turns site photos and voice notes into a professional PDF inspection report, on your phone, before you leave the site. Snap photos, mark the issue, talk. AI writes each finding (description, severity, responsible party, action) and the executive summary. On the next visit, track what's still open with before/after photos. Works offline. Bilingual reports (English/Spanish). Free on Android; Pro adds unlimited reports, cloud backup and your logo.

title: Okapi: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos | Product Hunt
og:title: Okapi: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos | Product Hunt
og:description: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. It is built for developers whose apps and agents depend on third-party APIs. These APIs change all the time, and one breaking change can take your app down in production. Okapi keeps your code up to date with every API it calls, so your app keeps working and your team stops chasing changelogs. Okapi works with any API and is 100% free.

title: One Roof: Mission control for many coding agents | Product Hunt
og:title: One Roof: Mission control for many coding agents | Product Hunt
og:description: One place for chorus coding: several sessions of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi and Antigravity working together, with you in charge. Real terminals, one Inbox for everything they ask you, and a morning page that says what happened overnight. Free and open source.

title: Opal Reader: Read PDFs and EPUBs on iPhone Duo | Product Hunt
og:title: Opal Reader: Read PDFs and EPUBs on iPhone Duo | Product Hunt
og:description: Opal Reader is a PDF and EPUB reader with a notebook beside the page. On iPhone Duo, unfold to read your book and your notes together, then fold it closed and keep reading in a compact view with your place saved. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

title: Open : The Full Stack Customer Communications Engine | Product Hunt
og:title: Open  : The Full Stack Customer Communications Engine  | Product Hunt
og:description: Open is one engine for every customer conversation. Its AI support already handles the customers you have across voice, chat, email, WhatsApp, SMS and Slack. Open for Sales goes after the next ones. Give Companion your products and a CSV of contacts. It checks every persona, scores who fits, writes a sequence across calls, email and WhatsApp that you edit before it sends, then builds a live dashboard to track results. One prompt, a full campaign, on the same platform your support runs on.

title: OpenAI: APIs and tools for building AI products | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenAI: APIs and tools for building AI products | Product Hunt
og:description:
The most powerful platform for building AI products.

Build and scale AI experiences powered by industry-leading models and tools.

title: OpenMail: Give your AI agents an identity through email | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenMail: Give your AI agents an identity through email | Product Hunt
og:description: Your agents sign up for tools, receive verification codes and reply to customers, mostly from your Gmail or a shared sending pool where one bad actor gets everyone flagged. OpenMail gives every AI agent its own inbox on your domain with its own sending reputation, for one API call each. Incoming mail reaches your code over webhook or WebSocket, attachments arrive as text, and there's a hosted MCP server and a Hermes plugin. Built and hosted in the EU, free for 3 inboxes.

title: openring: Open-source voice AI agents with no platform fee | Product Hunt
og:title: openring: Open-source voice AI agents with no platform fee | Product Hunt
og:description: Self-hosted voice AI agents with a Vapi-compatible API. AI phone agents on Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Vonage or SIP, with your keys or 100% local and free (Whisper, Ollama, Kokoro). No per-minute platf...

title: OpenVibe: A canvas of real terminals for your AI coding agents | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenVibe: A canvas of real terminals for your AI coding agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Desktop app that runs your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider and more) in real terminals on an infinite canvas. Group them into teams, brief a team in one line, review their changes, and hand a big task to an orchestrator. Windows, MIT.

title: Operum: Your AI product team, with expert workflows built in | Product Hunt
og:title: Operum: Your AI product team, with expert workflows built in | Product Hunt
og:description: Build and launch software without managing AI agents. The Operum desktop app gives founders and developers a coordinated AI product team: PM, Architect, Engineer, Tester, Marketing, Community. Describe your goal in chat; agents plan, build in your GitHub repo, independently test changes, and help you launch. Expert workflows and human approvals are built in, with optional auto-merge. Use Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex. Engines change; your team stays. Free plan + 14-day Premium trial. No card.

title: OpusClip: Hot | Product Hunt
og:title: OpusClip: Hot | Product Hunt
og:description: OpusClip turns long videos into high-quality viral clips, and publishes them to all social platforms in one click. We help 10M+ creators create and grow faster.

title: Oreja de Van Gogh: pause Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks | Product Hunt
og:title: Oreja de Van Gogh: pause Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks | Product Hunt
og:description: A macOS menu bar app that pauses or lowers Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks, then returns it at the level and position you chose.

title: Orphex MCP: Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP | Product Hunt
og:title: Orphex MCP: Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP | Product Hunt
og:description: Orphex is the unified MCP gateway for digital marketing teams, handling auth and integrations for 65+ platforms, from Google Ads to Shopify, to give your AI true cross-channel context. Move your AI beyond QA: empower it to analyze integrated performance and take every action a human marketer can. Reallocate budgets, pause unprofitable creatives, or adjust products from a single prompt. Every change is logged and protected by safety guardrails. Start free, 30% off the first month.

title: Ownkube: Deploy apps from your coding agent with one prompt | Product Hunt
og:title: Ownkube: Deploy apps from your coding agent with one prompt | Product Hunt
og:description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and your agent deploys the repo on Ownkube: the app, a managed Postgres and a cache, live on HTTPS. You sign in and approve the deploy. Apps bill per minute for what they use, so an idle app costs almost nothing. Credit you top up never expires. Bring your own cloud: when a customer wants your app in their own AWS account, you deploy the same app there with no rewrite, logs and metrics included.

title: PacerTrip: Pick a marathon abroad. We plan the trip around race day. | Product Hunt
og:title: PacerTrip: Pick a marathon abroad. We plan the trip around race day. | Product Hunt
og:description: Planning a marathon abroad means race dates, entry windows and fees on different sites, often not in your language. PacerTrip puts it in one app: 3,000+ races in 142 countries with entry dates and fees in your currency, a reminder the day before entry opens (big races can sell out on day one), stays sorted by distance to the start, an AI race-week itinerary, and a runner community for every race, auto-translated into your language. Free on iOS, Android and the web, in 44 languages.

title: Panda Video: Video Hosting Platform for Business and Creators | Product Hunt
og:title: Panda Video: Video Hosting Platform for Business and Creators | Product Hunt
og:description: Secure, ad-free video hosting for online courses, VSLs and EdTechs. Panda Video is the best solution to boost your business and your video marketing goals. Protect content with DRM Watermark, domain restrictions and Anti-Download. Boost engagement with AI dubbing, subtitles, and an AI Tutor. Maximize sales using Smart Autoplay, Video Funnels, and CTAs. Enjoy high-performance hosting with predictable costs based on storage and bandwidth, ensuring no unexpected billing surprises.

title: PasteGuard for Mac: Keep secrets and personal data out of AI chats | Product Hunt
og:title: PasteGuard for Mac: Keep secrets and personal data out of AI chats | Product Hunt
og:description: PasteGuard masks API keys, passwords, emails, card numbers and more on your Mac's clipboard the moment you copy, so every paste into ChatGPT, Claude, Slack or a terminal is safe. An optional Apple Intelligence check on your Mac catches what rules miss. For what only you know, add custom rules, import CSV word lists or keep an Ignore list. Restore puts the real values back. No permissions, no account, nothing leaves your Mac.

title: Paws: Meet strangers through their cats, behind frosted glass | Product Hunt
og:title: Paws: Meet strangers through their cats, behind frosted glass | Product Hunt
og:description: I’ve always found something quietly beautiful about brief encounters with strangers. Paws is a tiny room of other people’s cats, seen through frosted glass. Maybe one wanders over and presses a paw to your fingertip. Nothing to win. Just stay a while. 🐾

title: Pawse.ai: Sound engineered for dogs, not humans | Product Hunt
og:title: Pawse.ai: Sound engineered for dogs, not humans | Product Hunt
og:description:
Pawse.ai writes sound for your dog while it plays. Every session is shaped to how dogs hear, so it plays no recordings and no two sessions are the same.

Choose Sleep, Home Alone, Loud Noise, Travel or Vet Visit. After each session you tell it what your dog did, and the next session starts from that answer.

It runs on iPhone, iPad and Android. With an Apple TV, a session keeps playing after you leave the house.

A Pawse.ai subscription, Monthly or Yearly. Yearly starts with a free month.

title: Peji: An AI chat with a real browser you control | Product Hunt
og:title: Peji: An AI chat with a real browser you control | Product Hunt
og:description: The browser on your iPhone finishes the task. Ask for a price comparison, a flight, a PDF summary: Peji opens WebKit tabs, reads them, clicks and types, and keeps going until the job is done, with every step in the chat. It stops and waits for your tap before it sends, buys, pays or deletes. Chats, files and dictation stay on the phone. Answers that are a price list or a schedule come back as a table or a chart with the source links. Free on the App Store; Pro adds usage.

title: Pinku: Private AI chat that runs offline on your iPhone and Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Pinku: Private AI chat that runs offline on your iPhone and Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Pinku runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple's MLX. Download a model once and chat offline, even in airplane mode. No account, no server: your chats never leave your device. Free to start.

title: Pluto Door: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server | Product Hunt
og:title: Pluto Door: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server | Product Hunt
og:description: Meet Pluto Door, the Mac SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server. Ask Ori what's wrong in plain English; it shows every command first, and nothing runs until you approve. Pluto XOS turns any server into a desktop with 15 apps, and Classic keeps a fast terminal, file browser and editor. Works with AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Your servers, keys and history stay on your Mac. Free for 14 days, then $4.99 a month or $49.99 a year, or pay $59 once and keep every update.

title: Polylane: AI agents that fix issues before they become incidents | Product Hunt
og:title: Polylane: AI agents that fix issues before they become incidents | Product Hunt
og:description: Nobody should be on call. Polylane connects your code, infra and observability data, investigates every issue and opens a pull request with the fix.

title: PowerShips: Where battleships meets powers! | Product Hunt
og:title: PowerShips: Where battleships meets powers! | Product Hunt
og:description: Battleships with classes. Pick a class with an active ability and a passive, place your fleet and play a friend from a link or find an opponent online. Free, no sign-up.

title: Prelulu: Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story | Product Hunt
og:title: Prelulu: Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story | Product Hunt
og:description: Immersive stories with AI characters you can text or video roleplay with. It's our first time bringing real-time avatar technology to consumer scale. You can create your own characters with live avatar capability.

title: Prism: Cursor for hardware engineering | Product Hunt
og:title: Prism: Cursor for hardware engineering | Product Hunt
og:description: Prism is the AI platform for hardware engineering. CAD, physics solvers, 3D viewers, coding, and reporting together in one place, all driven by agents. Go from ideas to validated design effortlessly. Free to try on Windows, Mac and Linux.

title: Product Hunt: The place to discover your next favorite thing | Product Hunt
og:title: Product Hunt: The place to discover your next favorite thing | Product Hunt
og:description: Founded in 2013 as a tiny side project, Product Hunt has become the place for makers and companies to launch their latest app, gadget, or physical products to the world. It's a global community of friendly folks sharing and discussing the latest in tech.

title: Pushary: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Pushary: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Pushary sends your AI agents’ permission prompts and questions to the right person’s phone or Mac, and keeps a record of who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Hermes, for one developer or a whole team.

title: QualityLayer: Plan, build and review software with your coding agents | Product Hunt
og:title: QualityLayer: Plan, build and review software with your coding agents | Product Hunt
og:description: QualityLayer takes each code change through seven steps: Discuss, Research, Plan, Outline, Implement, Verify and Review. You comment on diagrams and clickable screens and approve the Plan before code changes. Your agent builds it test first, and a fresh agent that did not write the code checks the result against your request. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and four more on your own subscription, and runs on your computer. https://github.com/maxritter/qualitylayer

title: Quest: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life | Product Hunt
og:title: Quest: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life | Product Hunt
og:description: Most AI assistants help you get things done. Quest takes the time to understand your personality, values, ambitions, and motivations. More than just remembering conversations, it's a personal AI advisor that helps you reflect, navigate difficult choices, and make decisions aligned with who you are. Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

title: Quillo: Listen to any PDF in a natural voice, then ask Quillo Ai | Product Hunt
og:title: Quillo: Listen to any PDF in a natural voice, then ask Quillo Ai | Product Hunt
og:description: Quillo reads PDFs, Word files, photos and web pages aloud in a natural voice and highlights each sentence. Quillo Ai answers questions about your documents. Merge, compress, sign, scan and convert for free on Android, iPhone and the web.

title: QuotedPart: AI quoting for CNC and sheet metal job shops | Product Hunt
og:title: QuotedPart: AI quoting for CNC and sheet metal job shops | Product Hunt
og:description: QuotedPart reads the quote request and its files, then prices every quantity on your own machines and rates in under a minute. An estimator checks it and sends the quote. $399/mo per shop, first 20 shops $199.

title: Raah.dev: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance | Product Hunt
og:title: Raah.dev: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance | Product Hunt
og:description: Connect payments and conversions with page speed, API latency, errors, and ISP performance in one dashboard. Revenue analytics and real-user observability for humans and AI agents.

title: Rainbrand: The brand layer for agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Rainbrand: The brand layer for agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files. Give your agents the guidance and assets they need for marketing campaigns, websites, slides, email, video, and more. Keep that context current as your brands evolve. Use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or build it into your product through the API.

title: Remote Gaze: Your Mac on your iPad and iPhone with no in-between server | Product Hunt
og:title: Remote Gaze: Your Mac on your iPad and iPhone with no in-between server | Product Hunt
og:description: Remote Gaze puts your whole Mac on your iPad or iPhone at Retina resolution, up to 120fps, with touch, trackpad, keyboard and Apple Pencil. Nothing passes through anyone else's server: devices connect directly, end to end encrypted, with per-device keys in the Secure Enclave and Face ID gating. Gaze Host, the free Mac companion, gives a headless Mac mini a display of its own.

title: Render: The cloud for AI-native applications | Product Hunt
og:title: Render: The cloud for AI-native applications | Product Hunt
og:description: Render is the AI-native cloud platform, used by more than 8 million builders. It gives teams an intuitive way to deploy and scale the AI agents inside their products, the long-running services behind them, and the data they depend on, all on a single platform. Git-based deploys, private networking, and preview environments come built in, with no glue code to write.

title: Rerun: The easiest way to build AI agents for all your tasks | Product Hunt
og:title: Rerun: The easiest way to build AI agents for all your tasks | Product Hunt
og:description: Most AI agents are black boxes. Rerun isn't. Build no-code agents that run 24/7, chasing invoices, qualifying leads, clearing your inbox, and watch every step in real time. They pause for approval before anything sensitive. Each workspace gets its own private server. Start with the included model, or connect your own API key or subscription

title: Resum: API and SDK for live conversations | Product Hunt
og:title: Resum: API and SDK for live conversations | Product Hunt
og:description: Enterprise API and SDK that connects a live conversation to named AI agents. A transcript while the session is open, then one file per agent when it ends.

title: Riverside: Record, edit & publish podcasts & videos, all in one place | Product Hunt
og:title: Riverside: Record, edit & publish podcasts & videos, all in one place | Product Hunt
og:description: Riverside is an end-to-end platform for creating studio-quality videos and podcasts, from recording and live streaming to editing, repurposing and distribution, all with the help of powerful AI.

title: Rodeo: A Notion alternative with AI meeting notes on the free plan | Product Hunt
og:title: Rodeo: A Notion alternative with AI meeting notes on the free plan | Product Hunt
og:description: Rodeo is a workspace for docs, wikis and databases your team edits together in real time. AI meeting notes come with every plan, including Free: transcript, summary, decisions and tasks. Plus Ask AI, an AI canvas and a built-in MCP server. Imports Notion.

title: Rungle: Turn your running photos and clips into share-ready Reels | Product Hunt
og:title: Rungle: Turn your running photos and clips into share-ready Reels | Product Hunt
og:description: Rungle is a free iPhone app that turns your runs into posts. Import distance, pace, heart rate and more from Apple Health (or a screenshot of your running app) and put them on your photos with stylish overlays. AI best cuts picks shots worth sharing, and Reel templates like KM Splits and Spider Shot come with filming guides. Running Courses helps you find your next route on a map. Keep your running app. Rungle handles the edit.

title: RunThru: Video proof that your agent's pull request works | Product Hunt
og:title: RunThru: Video proof that your agent's pull request works | Product Hunt
og:description: Comment /runthru on a pull request. An agent uses the feature on your preview, films a narrated walkthrough, and a second model grades whether it works. Video and verdict land in the PR in 5 minutes, with a share link and a Slack post. Free: 5 videos a month.

title: SafetyClip: A clipboard manager for Mac that keeps secrets secret | Product Hunt
og:title: SafetyClip: A clipboard manager for Mac that keeps secrets secret | Product Hunt
og:description: SafetyClip is a clipboard manager for Mac. It saves everything you copy, so you can press ⌃⌘V in any app, search, and paste it again. But a clipboard history also collects your passwords and API keys. So SafetyClip spots them as you copy them and locks them behind Touch ID. A copied API key comes off the clipboard right away, so it isn't there for other apps to read, and you can't paste it into an AI chat by mistake. Everything stays on your Mac. $8 once, full Swift source included.

title: SageCraft: An open-source harness for a decision model playing WoW | Product Hunt
og:title: SageCraft: An open-source harness for a decision model playing WoW | Product Hunt
og:description: An open-source harness that lets Sage play World of Warcraft through screenshots and keystrokes. Inspect 4,573 decisions, the fixes behind a level-five run, or replay recorded events offline. Live play needs macOS, WoW and a Sage API key.

title: AgentKit (by Scalekit): MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf | Product Hunt
og:title: AgentKit (by Scalekit): MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf | Product Hunt
og:description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

title: Scrawl: Show your AI agent the problem with a visual frame | Product Hunt
og:title: Scrawl: Show your AI agent the problem with a visual frame | Product Hunt
og:description: Scrawl records your screen, voice, clicks and drawings, then packs them into one compact capture you paste into your AI coding agent. Press ⌥⇧S, talk, click and draw. Frames are taken only when something happens, speech is transcribed on your Mac, and each frame is cropped to where you worked. Works with iPhone mirroring and ScrawlKit for iOS apps. Open source (MIT). macOS 15+, Apple silicon.

title: Screen Studio: Beautiful screen recordings, in minutes. | Product Hunt
og:title: Screen Studio: Beautiful screen recordings, in minutes.  | Product Hunt
og:description: Screen Studio makes your mouse movement smooth, automatically zooms in on clicks, applies cinematic motion blur to all the animations, and adds beautiful background around your recording. In a minute your recording becomes a high-quality promotional video.

title: Scrollsnacks: Launch videos, broken down second by second | Product Hunt
og:title: Scrollsnacks: Launch videos, broken down second by second | Product Hunt
og:description: Launch videos broken into timed hook, problem, solution, feature, proof and CTA sections. Search them by brand or section, or from your AI tools via MCP.

title: seam: Turn your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island | Product Hunt
og:title: seam: Turn your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island | Product Hunt
og:description: Seam turns the notch into a Dynamic Island. Dictate into any app, control music, see when Claude Code finishes and run a focus timer. Voice runs on your Mac. $19.90 once for 2 Macs, with a 48-hour free trial and no card.

title: Seamcult: A pattern design tool for the LLM era ('paper' for patterns) | Product Hunt
og:title: Seamcult: A pattern design tool for the LLM era ('paper' for patterns) | Product Hunt
og:description: Give any MCP agent — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral — a photo, a paper pattern or a brief, and it drafts on a mannequin built from your measurements while you watch. Or rework what you have: refit it to another size, split a piece, add a pocket, move a seam — just ask. Seamcult audits the geometry, so the agent works from facts, not guesses. Sketch a fix on the canvas and the agent gets it as an image. Print on A4 at home, export PLT or DXF, or share a read-only link. Free in early access.

title: Secret Key: Let your family unlock your passwords if you can't | Product Hunt
og:title: Secret Key: Let your family unlock your passwords if you can't | Product Hunt
og:description: Open-source, self-hosted emergency access for your password database. Split the master password into pieces for people you trust (e.g. any 3 of 5 unlock it). Access needs SMS verification and a 48-hour delay you can cancel with one click.

title: Seldon: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do | Product Hunt
og:title: Seldon: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do | Product Hunt
og:description: Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free.

title: Sendoff: Say "send it." to automatically email your list | Product Hunt
og:title: Sendoff: Say "send it." to automatically email your list | Product Hunt
og:description: Sendoff emails your list (newsletters, launches, announcements) from Claude or Codex, self-hosted on your own Cloudflare and AWS accounts and sending through Amazon SES.

title: Sendu: Drop files easily across your local network | Product Hunt
og:title: Sendu: Drop files easily across your local network | Product Hunt
og:description: Drop files easily over your local Wi-Fi: iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux, and Android TV. No cloud, no cables, no account — devices talk directly, end-to-end encrypted. Send photos, 4K videos, or whole folders in three taps at full local speed. Stream native-quality video to a D-pad Android TV app, or share a folder once and pull files from any device. Files never leave your network. P2P file transfer is free. Sendu Pro unlocks TV streaming and live shared folders.

title: Seqora: Design your schema on a canvas. Seqora writes the SQL. | Product Hunt
og:title: Seqora: Design your schema on a canvas. Seqora writes the SQL. | Product Hunt
og:description: A desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite. Change tables on an ER canvas and Seqora writes the SQL. Every index, constraint, trigger and function gets its own page with size, usage and health. Visual EXPLAIN shows the plan step by step with measured timings. macOS and Windows, no account.

title: Sequence · Video Editor: Create What Matters. Find the Story Faster | Product Hunt
og:title: Sequence · Video Editor: Create What Matters. Find the Story Faster | Product Hunt
og:description:
Turn your recordings into a rough cut. Search, shape and export.

Edit like a doc, normalize audio, remove filler, clean-up profanity, search and organize, export directly or to Final Cut Pro.

All on-device. No Cloud. Private by Design.
Optional MCP/CLI for agents to speed up editing workflows even further.

Featured in Larry Jordan's Edit Smarter Newsletter.

title: SKI: Voice-first coding harness for all your agents | Product Hunt
og:title: SKI: Voice-first coding harness for all your agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Run all your coding agents at once and talk to them. They ask out loud, you answer by voice, nothing merges without your review. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more, on the plans you already have.

title: skuttr: Type one sentence, get a Reel from your camera roll | Product Hunt
og:title: skuttr: Type one sentence, get a Reel from your camera roll | Product Hunt
og:description: skuttr turns one sentence into a ready-to-post Reel. Type “Tokyo solo trip” and it finds the right photos and videos on your iPhone, puts the strongest shot first and has a vertical Reel ready in under a minute. Your first 5 Reels are free.

title: SnapTiles: Build with magnetic tiles in 3D, free in your browser | Product Hunt
og:title: SnapTiles: Build with magnetic tiles in 3D, free in your browser | Product Hunt
og:description: Magnetic tiles in 3D, free in the browser. Drag tiles out and they snap edge to edge like the real ones, and gravity knocks down a roof that wouldn't hold. Crash it, rebuild it, or start from a ready-made build. If you use Claude, it can also rebuild a tile build from an Instagram or YouTube video.

title: Sonari: A hand-gesture instrument and MIDI controller for Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Sonari: A hand-gesture instrument and MIDI controller for Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: A hand-gesture Mac instrument and MIDI controller. Play built-in sounds and music-driven visuals, or send hand gestures straight to a compatible DAW as MIDI. Try 17 styles or the camera-free Key Deck. Free 14-day trial. Requires Apple silicon, macOS 26+.

title: SpaceO: Give AI agents their own screen on your Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: SpaceO: Give AI agents their own screen on your Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Give AI agents a separate display for real Mac apps while you keep working. Connect through MCP or the CLI, watch sessions in the Viewer, and take over when an agent needs help. Supports native apps and Chromium. Free and MIT licensed; Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Attention isolation, not a security sandbox: apps run as your macOS user. Runtime support depends on your macOS build.

title: Standflow: Sit, stand, perch, and move on a rhythm from your menu bar | Product Hunt
og:title: Standflow: Sit, stand, perch, and move on a rhythm from your menu bar | Product Hunt
og:description: Standflow is a standing desk timer that lives in your Mac's menu bar. It guides you through a cycle of sitting, standing, perching on a tall stool, and short movement breaks, so you change posture often instead of sitting (or standing) all day. Start from a preset like Easy Start, based on the 20-8-2 guideline, or drag the cycle ring to build your own. Reminders can move on automatically or ask first. Track a daily standing goal and 7/30/90-day metrics. No account: your data stays on your Mac.

title: Stitch.ai: Your new workspace with mail, calendar and tasks built in | Product Hunt
og:title: Stitch.ai: Your new workspace with mail, calendar and tasks built in | Product Hunt
og:description: Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards, and files into one connected workspace. Stitchy, your AI assistant, works with you across it all. Dual workspace panels allow you to drag, drop, and Stitch anything to everything. Nothing gets lost. AI-powered Knots, Tags, and Connections keep your work organized and easy to surface. Everything is built in: no integrations or extra email clients to set up. Get your work done in one place, without losing context.

title: Billing MCP By SubscriptionFlow: Open Source AI Agent to Run Your Subscription Billing | Product Hunt
og:title: Billing MCP By SubscriptionFlow: Open Source AI Agent to Run Your Subscription Billing | Product Hunt
og:description: Monetize your AI apps and assistants down to the single action, using Stripe, PayPal, NMI, Authorize.net and other major payment gateways. With the SubscriptionFlow MCP billing plugin, bill customers per question answered, task completed, or custom action. Offer prepaid credit wallets or post-billing with real-time balance checks that eliminate overspending. Set dynamic usage rates, automate metering, and protect margins, turning AI consumption into automated revenue.

title: SUN: Create podcasts, audiobook, and audio courses instantly | Product Hunt
og:title: SUN: Create podcasts, audiobook, and audio courses instantly | Product Hunt
og:description: SUN turns any topic into a personalized AI generated audio course you can listen to while living your life. Instead of static libraries, users create interactive courses on demand, ask questions during playback, and learn hands free during commutes, walks, or workouts. Built for continuous, screen free learning that fits naturally into daily routines.

title: Rex (Beta): Building the multiplexer for all work | Product Hunt
og:title: Rex (Beta): Building the multiplexer for all work | Product Hunt
og:description: Hello, world. We've been building a terminal multiplexer and we think you're going to love it. Native apps (e.g., macOS/iOS), accessible from the web, multiplayer. From the creators of Ghostty and Echo.

title: Switchy: Mac controls, deploys, 2FA & AI limits in your menu bar | Product Hunt
og:title: Switchy: Mac controls, deploys, 2FA & AI limits in your menu bar | Product Hunt
og:description: Mac switches, deploy status, local servers, 2FA codes and Claude/Codex limits in one native menu bar panel. Apple silicon, macOS 14+. Free for 7 days without an account or card, then $4.99 once for up to 3 Macs.

title: Synter Canvas: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms | Product Hunt
og:title: Synter Canvas: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms | Product Hunt
og:description: Your AI agent builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across 30+ ad platforms, with safety gates and guardrails on every change. $0.25 per verified write, 0% of ad spend.

title: Tao Browser: Private browser with a separate login for every company | Product Hunt
og:title: Tao Browser: Private browser with a separate login for every company | Product Hunt
og:description: Tao Browser keeps each company, client or project in its own space with its own cookies and logins. Lock tabs with Face ID or Touch ID, block ads and trackers on your device, import from Arc. No account, no telemetry. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac (beta).

title: telemetry.dev: Observability for AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: telemetry.dev: Observability for AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

title: TellPip: A little bird that whispers what to say in your calls | Product Hunt
og:title: TellPip: A little bird that whispers what to say in your calls | Product Hunt
og:description: TellPip listens to your calls from your Mac (no bot joins), transcribes on-device, remembers what you promised each client and whispers the answer from your own documents when you're asked. Invisible in screen sharing. Built in Europe, with GDPR in mind.

title: Termy: Your coding agent, in the notch | Product Hunt
og:title: Termy: Your coding agent, in the notch | Product Hunt
og:description: Claude Code and Codex in a terminal that drops down from your MacBook's notch. Live status, approvals from the notch, an office of your agents, a browser for your local server, on-device dictation and checkpoints.

title: Terse - Durable Actors: Infrastructure for Multiplayer AI Products | Product Hunt
og:title: Terse - Durable Actors: Infrastructure for Multiplayer AI Products | Product Hunt
og:description: We provide an army of tiny servers to help you build incredible and cost efficient Multiplayer AI at scale. It's an open source alternative to Cloudflare's Durable Objects. Each resource or agent gets it's own micro-vm with a co-located SQLite DB. It can only process one request at a time making it concurrency safe. Onboard each one, is a websocket server. Allowing clients of any form to connect and listen for events on the resource.

title: Testera: AI-driven API testing | Product Hunt
og:title: Testera: AI-driven API testing | Product Hunt
og:description: Free test management with hosted MCP for any AI client — Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, VS Code, or your own agents. Agentic Test Management on Advanced: triage CI failures, draft-PR self-heal, automations, and webhooks.

title: Testifly launch: AI-powered end-to-end full web testing in minutes | Product Hunt
og:title: Testifly launch: AI-powered end-to-end full web testing in minutes | Product Hunt
og:description: From URL to fully automated end-to-end web testing in minutes! Testifly makes end-to-end web testing fast, stable, and low-maintenance. After providing your URL and logins, Testifly creates reliable tests in minutes using AI that understands real user flows and adapts to UI changes. No long setup, no brittle scripts, fewer flaky failures. Built on modern browser automation and designed for real production apps, CI pipelines, and fast-moving teams.

title: TextKit: Send + receive texts in the US and Canada with a simple API | Product Hunt
og:title: TextKit: Send + receive texts in the US and Canada with a simple API | Product Hunt
og:description: One API to send and receive texts, verify phone numbers and buy local or toll-free numbers in the US and Canada. Test mode runs every call without texting real people. We file your 10DLC registration. SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. Per text costs of TextKit are half or less of the base rate at the big SMS APIs. A simple SMS api that just works. Integrates in 100+ services including claude and chatGPT. AI-assisted campaign registrations. Human support. Also - 50% cheaper than Twilio

title: Textly: Capture Text & Tables: Capture Text & Tables from Anywhere on Your Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Textly: Capture Text & Tables: Capture Text & Tables from Anywhere on Your Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop retyping text and rebuilding tables. Textly makes it effortless to capture text from anywhere on your Mac, including images, videos, PDFs, and apps—even when text can't be selected or copied. Instantly extract tables while preserving rows and columns, export them to CSV, Markdown, or TSV, and translate captured text into different languages. Access and search your clipboard history anytime. One simple tool for all your text and table capture needs.

title: The Writer's Quarter: AI-Free Writing & Novel Planning Software | Product Hunt
og:title: The Writer's Quarter: AI-Free Writing & Novel Planning Software | Product Hunt
og:description: Write your manuscript, build your characters and keep every part of your story connected in one calm, visual, AI-free workspace.

title: Tilde : Finder replacement & file manager for mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Tilde : Finder replacement & file manager for mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Tilde is the native Finder replacement for Mac. Browse folders in custom split layouts, organise files by status or client with custom properties, restore tabs and layouts with saved workspaces, and too much more to list. Purchase once, no subscription.

title: Tinker: Control every aspect of model training and fine-tuning | Product Hunt
og:title: Tinker: Control every aspect of model training and fine-tuning | Product Hunt
og:description: Tinker is a flexible API for efficiently fine-tuning open source models with LoRA. It's designed for researchers and developers who want flexibility and full control of their data and algorithms without worrying about infrastructure management.

title: Tokens by UI Colors: Build your product’s visual language with design tokens | Product Hunt
og:title: Tokens by UI Colors: Build your product’s visual language with design tokens | Product Hunt
og:description: Tokens is a visual playground for creating a unique visual language for your digital product. Explore colors, typography, spacing, radius, and shadows with simple controls, then fine-tune every detail with advanced customization options. Tokens uses a reusable system of primitive and semantic design tokens to help keep your interfaces consistent across websites, SaaS products, and apps, whether built by humans or AI agents. Export it as CSS variables or a DESIGN.md file.

title: TOWeb: Build websites & online stores on Mac/PC, no subscription | Product Hunt
og:title: TOWeb: Build websites & online stores on Mac/PC, no subscription | Product Hunt
og:description: TOWeb 15 is a desktop app for Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows that builds fast, accessible websites and online stores without code. Write directly on the page, pick a complete style, add a shop or bookings. An AI assistant writes copy and translates, locally or in the cloud, and in the Studio edition Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini can drive TOWeb through MCP. Works offline, publishes to any web host. Free Standard edition, paid editions are a one-time purchase.

title: TrackEdge: Hidden AI buttons on your MacBook’s trackpad | Product Hunt
og:title: TrackEdge: Hidden AI buttons on your MacBook’s trackpad | Product Hunt
og:description: TrackEdge turns the edges of a MacBook trackpad into controls. Slide along the right edge for volume, the left edge for display brightness, and the bottom edge for media playback. Double-tap either top corner to mute, open an app or website, press a keyboard shortcut, or run a Shortcuts action.

title: UnleashX: The AI workforce that turns conversations into outcomes. | Product Hunt
og:title: UnleashX: The AI workforce that turns conversations into outcomes.  | Product Hunt
og:description: UnleashX lets you hire AI employees like people - pick a role, connect your CRM and tools, set your rules, and hand over the work. Execute workflows end-to-end, with humans stepping in only when needed.

title: Usage for Claude: Track your claude subscription usage | Product Hunt
og:title: Usage for Claude: Track your claude subscription usage | Product Hunt
og:description: Never hit your limits unexpectedly. Monitor your Claude subscription usage right from your menu bar with automatic tracking of both your current session and weekly limits. Get notified when you're approaching your limit so you can plan your work accordingly and never be caught off guard.

title: Vectorize: Agents that remember. Agents that learn. | Product Hunt
og:title: Vectorize: Agents that remember. Agents that learn. | Product Hunt
og:description: Introducing Hindsight™, a new approach to agent memory. Best in the world on benchmarks. Best in production for your agents.

title: VeilCC: Ship code AI can't reverse engineer | Product Hunt
og:title: VeilCC: Ship code AI can't reverse engineer | Product Hunt
og:description: Ship code AI can't reverse-engineer. VeilCC hardens it with AI-resistant obfuscation and seals your key logic, so attackers can't crack, clone, or cheat your game or app.

title: Vibeconferencing: Your Claude Code session, in your Meet, Zoom or Teams call | Product Hunt
og:title: Vibeconferencing: Your Claude Code session, in your Meet, Zoom or Teams call | Product Hunt
og:description: Vibeconferencing puts your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or a local model) into your call as a participant, with a face and a voice. It hears the room, talks back, and builds on a shared whiteboard while you talk. Works in Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack huddles, WhatsApp, Telegram and phone calls. Free and open source.

title: Videco: Turn every video into a content campaign. | Product Hunt
og:title: Videco: Turn every video into a content campaign. | Product Hunt
og:description: Creating content from scratch takes time. Videco helps you host your videos and turn webinars, demos and recordings into AI clips, blog posts and social media content in one place.

title: VinSage: Free used-car check in Chrome's side panel, US & CA | Product Hunt
og:title: VinSage: Free used-car check in Chrome's side panel, US & CA | Product Hunt
og:description: VinSage sits beside any used-car listing in Chrome and shows NHTSA and Transport Canada recalls, crash ratings, owner complaints, fuel cost and a 0–100 deal score, plus a negotiation pack. Core checks are free. No account, no ads, no analytics.

title: Virelo: Turn your video folders into a private streaming library | Product Hunt
og:title: Virelo: Turn your video folders into a private streaming library | Product Hunt
og:description: Give your local videos a streaming-style home. Browse your folders, swipe through Shorts, build playlists, and smooth out volume differences. Use Virelo in your browser with no signup or uploads, or self-host with npx virelo for user accounts, library permissions, and automatic metadata and artwork. Free and open source.

title: Wanaka Studio: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine | Product Hunt
og:title: Wanaka Studio: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine | Product Hunt
og:description: The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

title: Watchflows: Visual automation for your Mac, with AI built in | Product Hunt
og:title: Watchflows: Visual automation for your Mac, with AI built in | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop doing the same Mac chores by hand. Watchflows runs them the moment something happens: a file lands in Downloads, you press a hotkey, a webhook arrives, it's 8:30 on a weekday. Wire triggers, conditions, actions and AI on a canvas, or describe it in plain English and the Flow Builder assembles it. AI reads, renames and decides mid-flow, on Watchflows AI, Apple's on-device model, Ollama, or your own keys. Local-first, no account. 14-day free trial, then $49 once. Also on Setapp.

title: Wavefunction: A minimal, open-source coding agent for your Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Wavefunction: A minimal, open-source coding agent for your Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Coding agents keep turning into super apps. Wavefunction goes the other way: a minimal desktop app built for coding. Keep chatting while it works on several tasks in parallel. Use your ChatGPT subscription, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter or a local model. Computer use runs on its own desktop, not yours. Free and open source.

title: Widgeteer: Describe a widget, get a working one on your site | Product Hunt
og:title: Widgeteer: Describe a widget, get a working one on your site | Product Hunt
og:description: Type what you need, like "a cleaning quote calculator" or "a table booking form", and Widgeteer builds a working widget. Edit it by hand or by asking. Submissions go to email, Zapier, n8n or a webhook. Works on WordPress, Shopify and any website.

title: Willder: AI agents coordinate. People collaborate. One memory. | Product Hunt
og:title: Willder: AI agents coordinate. People collaborate. One memory. | Product Hunt
og:description: Every AI tool I used forgot everything the second a session ended. So I built Willder: one shared memory graph that a team works through together, with real access control gating every read and write. Each person can run multiple customizable AI agents on top of it. Agents can coordinate through the graph without sharing a conversation. Nothing an agent drafts ships without your approval. Built solo. Would love your feedback, happy to talk through the architecture or the access-control model.

title: Wingmen: Agentic outreach with real intent data | Product Hunt
og:title: Wingmen: Agentic outreach with real intent data | Product Hunt
og:description: Wingmen finds people already showing they need what you sell: a post about the problem, a new hire, a job change. It scores who's worth reaching and why, writes the opener from what they actually said, and follows up on autopilot until there's a call on your calendar. Run it in the web app or straight from Claude with the Wingmen MCP. Built for agency founders and consultants who sell B2B.

title: Wipecraft: Mac System Data cleaner with on-device AI mode | Product Hunt
og:title: Wipecraft: Mac System Data cleaner with on-device AI mode | Product Hunt
og:description: macOS shows System Data as one number. Wipecraft lists what is in it, and in the rest of the disk, with each item's size and what removing it does. It knows what Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Xcode, simulators and Docker leave behind, and locks work in progress. Ask Overview a question with AI mode, which runs on your Mac. Safe cleanup can run on a schedule. Nothing comes selected; what does not rebuild itself goes to Quarantine for 30 days. Scanning is free; cleaning is a one-time license.

title: Xmind: The most professional and popular mind mapping tool | Product Hunt
og:title: Xmind: The most professional and popular mind mapping tool | Product Hunt
og:description:
Xmind is a full-featured mind mapping and brainstorming tool that helps to unleash creativity, capture inspiration, and boost productivity.
You’ve never mind mapped like this before: brainstorm ideas, organize with outline and present your mind map in just one place with premium experience across all platforms.

title: Yuzu Sync: Mirror, copy or two-way sync folders on your Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Yuzu Sync: Mirror, copy or two-way sync folders on your Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: A small menu-bar app that keeps pairs of folders in sync with a bundled rsync engine. Mirror a project to an SSD, copy photos to a NAS, or sync both ways. Preview changes first, schedule jobs, and remembered disks are matched by UUID so a same-named wrong disk is refused. Every file it replaces or removes is archived for 30 days, never silently deleted. macOS 14+.

title: Zerg Client: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes | Product Hunt
og:title: Zerg Client: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes | Product Hunt
og:description: Zerg AI's own coding harness, in evaluation beta. Ask for Vim or htop and the agent opens them in panes beside it. Panes can hold more agents, each on its own model. Available models depend on your sign-in route and provider access. Mac with Apple chips.

title: Zigzag Browser: The polished, native Mac browser for life after Arc | Product Hunt
og:title: Zigzag Browser: The polished, native Mac browser for life after Arc | Product Hunt
og:description: A native Mac browser for people leaving Arc, with the sidebar and spaces you're used to. Built on WebKit, not Chromium, and that's the point: the whole app is 18 MB (Arc is 871). Switching takes a minute. One import brings over everything, so you're already logged in. Colored spaces you swipe between, split view, peek, Chrome extensions like 1Password and Tampermonkey, and ad blocking built-in Open source, no account, no AI. Nobody can shut it down.

title: ZUS: AI-native IDE: agents code with human review | Product Hunt
og:title: ZUS: AI-native IDE: agents code with human review | Product Hunt
og:description: ZUS is a desktop IDE with an AI agent built in. The agent reads your codebase, plans, edits and runs commands within the permissions you grant. You read every diff before keeping it, undo what it got wrong, and see each subagent's tool calls in Team Inspector. Your project index and context stay on your machine, and you connect your own AI provider. Built on Tauri 2 and Rust, with a ~20 MB Windows installer. Runs on Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux.

og:title: RCE-уязвимость в ядре WordPress активно эксплуатируют злоумышленники
og:description: Агентство по кибербезопасности и защите инфраструктуры США (CISA) предупредило, что злоумышленники атакуют уязвимость CVE-2026-119977 в ядре WordPress. Баг позволяет выполнить код без аутентификации во время обновления движка, и специалисты Wordfence пишут, что всего за сутки заблокировали почти 63 000 попыток эксплуатации.

title: Microsoft патчит RCE-уязвимость в Windows Paint — Хакер
og:title: Microsoft патчит RCE-уязвимость в Windows Paint
og:description: Разработчики Microsoft подготовили патч для уязвимости CVE-2026-83844, обнаруженной в Windows Paint. Проблема позволяет удаленно выполнить код без аутентификации и каких-либо действий со стороны пользователя. При этом патч распространяется через Microsoft Store, а установка обычных исправлений через Windows Update сама по себе Paint не обновляет.

title: Почти 1000 коммутаторов Zyxel взломаны через уязвимость, от которой не защищал патч — Хакер
og:title: Почти 1000 коммутаторов Zyxel взломаны через уязвимость, от которой не защищал патч
og:description: Специалисты компании Binarly выяснили, что июньский патч для коммутаторов Zyxel GS1900 не защищал от эксплоита, который хакеры использовали для взлома почти 1000 устройств. В итоге злоумышленники задействовали в атаках новую 0-day-уязвимость, позволявшую без аутентификации выполнять команды с правами root.

title: Уязвимость SSHole уже взяли на вооружение хакеры — Хакер
og:title: Уязвимость SSHole уже взяли на вооружение хакеры
og:description: ИБ-специалисты предупреждают, что злоумышленники уже применяют в реальных атаках новую уязвимость SSHole (также известную как sshhole), которой присвоен идентификатор CVE-2026-123158. Баг возникает при взаимодействии OpenSSH и библиотеки musl libc, а его эксплуатация позволяет обойти аутентификацию в некоторых Linux-системах.
